questions.text: Can you describe a Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) system you have built and the key components you chose for indexing and retrieval?
Your resume says you built a multimodal image‑relevance service for FlyRank. What modalities did you support and how did you combine them to compute relevance?

In the flyrank‑capstone‑image‑relevance repo you added a design doc, ORM models, and an image‑tagging schema. Walk me through how you structured the database schema and why you chose those tables/relationships.
Imagine a FastAPI endpoint that should return image relevance scores but is returning 500 errors after a recent deployment. What systematic steps would you take to diagnose and fix the issue?
In your AI‑red‑teaming‑toolkit repo, the 01_extract_text.py script splits sections into ~700‑word chunks. Why did you pick that chunk size and how does it affect downstream retrieval?
You claim to have implemented unit tests for the backend services. Which testing framework did you use, and can you give an example of a critical test case you wrote?
Suppose you need to ship the Lead Generation Agent to a small business next month. How would you prioritize features and decide what to cut if time becomes limited?
The commit titled "Phase 1: organize and verify image dataset" was made on 2026‑08‑12. What verification steps did you implement to ensure dataset quality before training?

questions.text: Describe your workflow for using Git when collaborating on a shared codebase. How do you handle code reviews and merge conflicts?
Your resume notes that you integrated REST APIs for the image‑relevance service. What authentication method did you choose and why?
Explain the concept of Retrieval‑Augmented Generation to a product manager who is not technical. How would you convey its value in plain language?

The commit "Working end‑to‑end pipeline: prompt parsing, browser automation scraping, email extraction, Excel export, CLI and Streamlit frontend" shows a complex workflow. Break down the pipeline into its major components and discuss the most challenging integration point you faced.
